Activates when Struggle status ends; affects self — Max HP ▲ 5.06% continuously, stacks up to 5. SKIPPED: no shield-break / status-end trigger exists (nothing removes a shield in v1), so it never fires; the stat is also offensively inert for this kit (no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer).
skill2: Activates after landing 60 normal attacks while self is in Struggle status; affects the target — Taunts for 4 sec. SKIPPED: no taunt/aggro primitive and no boss-targeting model; zero damage path at scope.

Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part; affects all allies — Sustained damage ▲ 2.03%, stacks up to 5, lasts 15 sec. SKIPPED: TriggerDef has no part-destruction trigger and the scope-lock boss is partless, so the line is unreachable.

Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part; affects the 1 enemy with the highest ATK — 23.23% of final ATK as sustained damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. SKIPPED: same part-destruction trigger gap; unreachable against a partless boss.
burst: Activates when self is NOT in Struggle status; affects self — Max HP ▲ 10.09% for 10 sec. SKIPPED: negative self-status gate has no engine expression and the condition is unreachable at scope (the S1 Shield is never lost); the stat is offensively inert for this kit.

caveats: ⚑ 'Struggle' is a self-status with no engine primitive. It is modeled as the shield-present proxy (`requiresShielded`), which is exact for the positive branches and INEXPRESSIBLE for the two 'not in Struggle' branches — both are recorded in `unmodeled` rather than approximated.

⚑ Every Struggle-END and part-destruction branch is inert at scope lock (nothing breaks a shield; the boss is partless). If the sim ever models shield loss or destructible parts, the skill1 Max-HP stack line and both skill2 part lines must be re-derived, not resurrected as-is.
⚑ The base AR cadence tuple (ammo 60, reloadFrames 81, rate of fire) is datamined and unverified for this unit — normal-attack throughput is a hypothesis.

Burst-slot lines with no activation clause are keyed to `burstCast` (this unit's own Burst II cast), not `fullBurstEnter`; keying the ally Sustained buff to FB entry would over-credit rotations where another Burst II casts.
The whole modeled contribution of this unit is one team buff (Sustained damage ▲ 10.16% / 10 s) plus two self-shield events; skill2 contributes nothing at scope.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Modeled today: skill1 = a continuous self Shield worth 40.12% of final Max HP from t=0 (the 'Struggle' status carrier, no durationSec); burst = a self Shield-recovery of 15.04% of final Max HP gated on the owner holding a shield (`requiresShielded`, the Struggle proxy — always satisfied at scope), plus the kit's only offensive line, Sustained damage ▲ 10.16% to all allies including self for 10 s on her own burst cast. skill2 is deliberately EMPTY: all three of its lines hang off triggers the engine cannot express (a taunt after 60 landed normals, and two part-destruction riders) against a boss with no destructible parts — they are recorded verbatim-in-substance in `unmodeled` rather than approximated with an invented trigger. Both 'not in Struggle status' branches are likewise unmodelable (no inverse shield gate) and unreachable, since nothing in v1 removes a shield. This unit carries no direct damage, no weapon-state modifier, and no ATK/crit/core buff; its board footprint is the single Sustained-damage team buff and its interaction with any teammate that consumes shield events.

The engine has no self-status channel (`targetStatus`/`requiresTargetStatus` are enemy-only), and no inverse of `requiresShielded`, so the two 'not in Struggle' branches cannot be expressed at all and are left unmodeled rather than guessed.
